tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch a page of this site as plain Markdown. Pass the page's root-relative route, e.g. `/quickstart`.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List this site's pages: the llms.txt index of every page with its URL and summary, organized by section.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across this documentation site. Returns matching pages with their title, URL, and a short excerpt.
